findings.title: Cleanup targets the literal alias `alias`
findings.body: This registers cleanup against `identityProviders().get("alias")`, not the IDP created in the loop. The cleanup therefore leaves all generated `idp-alias-*` providers behind (and the later cleanup registration at line 425 has the same problem). The test can contaminate the shared test realm and fail on reruns or affect other tests.
